The Lifting Supervisor is responsible for overseeing and coordinating all lifting operations on site. This includes planning and preparing lifting activities involving tower cranes, mobile cranes, boom trucks, forklifts, gantry cranes, and related equipment. The role ensures all lifting tasks are performed safely, efficiently, and in full compliance with project requirements and regulatory standards. The Lifting Supervisor leads the lifting team and works closely with rigging personnel to assess conditions and guide proper execution of all lifting operations. 
 Key Responsibilities: 
 Health & Safety Responsibilities 
 Ensure all lifting equipment and materials are maintained in safe, operable condition, with all safety devices functional, calibrated, and properly certified.
 Enforce best practices in rigging and lifting techniques among all personnel.
 Maintain a consistently high standard of safety across all lifting activities.
 Verify that all required permits, documentation, and approvals are in place before lifting operations begin.
 Ensure all lifting equipment and devices comply with applicable Canadian standards and regulations in Ontario.
 Operational Responsibilities 
 Plan and prepare upcoming lifting activities, including equipment allocation, material requirements, task scheduling, and team dispatch in alignment with site priorities.
 Establish and implement clear procedures to ensure full understanding of lifting operations among lifting and logistics teams.
 Develop and enforce pre-start briefings and equipment-specific checklists for each type of machinery.
 Confirm that all operators and drivers complete required pre-shift equipment inspections.
 Conduct regular inspections of lifting devices to verify condition and readiness before each shift.
 Coordinate and organize lifting activities across all sites, ensuring efficient daily operation of lifting teams.
 Closely monitor the installation and operation of major equipment such as tower cranes, crawler cranes, and overhead cranes.
 Review and ensure strict adherence to approved lifting plans.
 Support equipment tracking and documentation of all Ontario Transit Group lifting devices.
 Maintain smooth team operations through proper planning of staffing, shift scheduling, and coverage.
 Collaborate closely with site engineers to ensure alignment of lifting activities with overall project goals.
 Perform daily on-site rounds to monitor team performance and provide coaching to improve skills.
 Adapt tasks and responsibilities as required throughout the duration of the project.
 Reporting Responsibilities 
 Ensure daily pre-start reports are completed and uploaded to the designated server.
 Collect and submit daily reports from site teams, including personnel attendance, hours worked, and tasks completed.
 Record hourly meters and/or kilometers of all on-site equipment (e.g., mobile cranes, heavy equipment) and provide updates to the Plant Engineer.
 Confirm that all lifting devices and equipment inspections are completed daily and forwarded to the Lifting Manager.
Minimum of 10+ years of experience within a construction-based Lifting Department, demonstrating a foundational understanding of lifting operations, site procedures, and safe equipment handling. Candidates with additional hands‑on exposure in heavy civil, industrial, or infrastructure projects will be considered an asset.
 Strong and up‑to‑date knowledge of lifting standards, regulations, and best practices, including safe rigging methods, equipment limitations, and compliance requirements relevant to construction environments.
 Valid Appointed Person Certification, confirming the ability to plan, supervise, and manage lifting operations while ensuring adherence to all safety protocols and legislative requirements.
 Proficiency in plant and logistics operations, including coordinating equipment movement, supporting site logistics planning, and ensuring efficient use of lifting assets across multiple work fronts.
 Demonstrated engineering and supervisory abilities, with the capacity to interpret technical documentation, review lifting plans, and oversee teams executing lifting and rigging tasks safely and effectively.
 Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, enabling clear direction to crews, coordination with site management, and effective collaboration with engineering, logistics, and HSE departments.
 Strong proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Word, and Outlook, with the ability to prepare reports, maintain equipment records, track documentation, and support daily operational administration.

 Global reach. Specialist expertise. Real influence.

 We want our people to grow with the business, build meaningful relationships and make a lasting contribution - not simply be part of the team, but help build the future of Equilibrium.
 The Role: 
 As an Intermediate Hydrogeologist , you’ll plan and deliver hydrogeological investigations, coordinate field programs, analyze and interpret groundwater data, and develop conceptual hydrogeological models to support engineering, mining, and natural resource projects. You’ll take increasing ownership of technical deliverables and project coordination, working closely with clients, project managers, and multidisciplinary teams while providing guidance to junior staff and contributing to high-quality project delivery.

 Plan & Deliver Projects: Plan and coordinate hydrogeological investigations, groundwater monitoring programs, and assigned project scopes, managing schedules, budgets, resources, and technical requirements in collaboration with accounting staff, project managers and senior hydrogeological engineers.
 Lead Field Investigations: Conduct and coordinate groundwater and surface water sampling, drilling, well installation and development, lithological logging, groundwater level monitoring, and hydraulic testing, including packer testing.  Analyze & Interpret Data: Compile, validate, manage, and interpret hydrogeological, geological, geochemical, climatological, and environmental data.  Manage Client & Project Relationships: Communicate technical findings, field observations, project progress, and recommendations to clients and multidisciplinary teams. Coordinate project activities, provide timely updates, and support effective client service and delivery.
 Mentor & Develop Others: Provide technical guidance to junior staff, share technical knowledge, and promote consistent field practices, analytical skills, and professional development.
 Support Business Development: Contribute to proposals, scopes of work, investigation methodologies, and resource planning while strengthening client relationships and supporting continuous improvement of technical practices.

 Experience preparing and reviewing technical reports, presentations, work plans, proposals, and other consulting deliverables.

 - You are passionate about recruiting and growing people and teams

 - You have excellent communication skills and believe that documentation is a great way to get feedback and discuss technical implementations and designs

 - You’re excited about AI and have the motivation to scale a company

We’re building the system that replaces the many tools owners use to run their business.

It powers everything from the restaurant’s website, online ordering, CRM, POS, and more.



Product philosophy

Most small business software makes owners do the work to get what they want: sales growth and profit growth. Owner does the work for them agentically.

Our system drives demand, converts it, and helps operators run their business day to day. As it improves, the business improves with it.

Using Owner should feel like having a team of great operators, engineers, and marketers working for you.



Our vision



We’re starting by helping independent restaurants succeed online.



But it’s not just restaurants that need our help. Most local businesses are struggling with these same problems. Huge technology corporations are taking their customers, bleeding their profits, and making it hard for them to survive.



Once we nail the solution for restaurants – we’ll scale it into every other local business type.



In the future we envision, tens of millions of local business owners will use our technology to succeed in the digital age.



Our traction



Since 2020, we've generated tens of millions in revenue and processed over a billion dollars of online orders. 1 in 5 Americans have used an Owner.com http://Owner.com website.

We’ll be scaling even faster in 2026 to keep pace with our customer growth.

 At Aviso, we are dedicated to improving the financial well-being of Canadians. If you are looking for interesting and challenging work, at a company committed to its people, find out more about what Aviso has to offer at www.aviso.ca .
 The Opportunity: 
 We are looking to fill an opening for a Senior Product Manager to join Aviso’s Product Management team and help shape the future of investing for Canadians through a best-in-class wealth advisor platform. 
 Reporting to the Director of Product Management, the Senior Product Manager will lead the Advisor Hub product family and directly own Advisor Hub ACP, which serves advisors at ACP introducing brokers and portfolio management firms. You will also manage and coach three Product Owners who own the other products in the family.
 You will help establish and champion our customer-centric product model: empowered, cross-functional teams that discover meaningful customer and business problems, test solutions early, and deliver value incrementally. Working in a leadership triad with a Product Designer and Tech Lead, you are accountable for product value and business viability; the Product Designer leads on desirability and usability; and the Tech Lead and engineers lead on technical feasibility. Together, you share responsibility for product outcomes and make informed trade-offs rather than treating feature delivery as the goal.
 This is both a hands-on product role and a people leadership role. You will bring a deep understanding of customers, product data and business constraints to the area you own, working with your team to discover solutions that deliver measurable outcomes. Across the product family, you will set direction, guide priorities and coach Product Owners to lead their areas as outcome-oriented product leaders rather than backlog administrators. You will also champion this way of working across Aviso, building trust through evidence, collaboration and incremental results as we continue to adopt the customer-centric product model.
 As one aviso: 
 We Care – You do the right thing for clients, partners and colleagues. You build trusted relationships, champion service excellence, and contribute to a culture where people feel valued and supported
 We Dare –You challenge the status quo with bold ideas and fresh perspectives. You embrace change, seek opportunities to innovate and are comfortable exploring new ways of working
 We Share – You collaborate openly and build meaningful relationships. You seek out diverse perspectives, share your knowledge and work together to help colleagues, clients and partners succeed
 We Deliver – You take ownership of your work, honour your commitments and focus on delivering meaningful results. You hold yourself accountable and continuously look for ways to improve
 What your day looks like: 
 Set product direction and measurable outcomes for the product family with the Director of Product Management; align the areas owned by your Product Owners with customer needs and Aviso’s business priorities
 Lead discovery in your own area and coach Product Owners to work with customers, users, data and stakeholders to understand problems, test assumptions, and evaluate opportunities before committing to solutions
 Partner with the Product Designer and Tech Lead in the leadership triad to explore options and balance value, viability, desirability and feasibility; involve engineers early and make trade-offs together
 Break larger opportunities into small, testable increments; collaborate with the team on a practical release plan, learn from each release, and adapt based on customer behaviour and measurable outcomes rather than feature output alone
 Own prioritization and the product backlog for your area, ensuring stories and other work are clear and ordered for implementation; support your Product Owners in doing the same, without taking ownership of engineering implementation or technical delivery
 Work with partners in compliance, privacy, operations, marketing, finance and technology to understand constraints early, address dependencies and ensure solutions can work for the business
 Manage, coach and develop Product Owners across their product areas, creating clarity on outcomes, strengthening discovery and judgement, and fostering collaborative relationships with design and technology counterparts
 Communicate product direction, evidence, trade-offs and results to stakeholders; advocate for the customer-centric product model, demonstrate its value through incremental wins, and help remove organizational barriers to its adoption
 Stay curious about investor needs, industry trends and the competitive landscape, using those insights to challenge assumptions and identify opportunities for meaningful improvement
 Requirements 
 Your experience and skills: 
 Innovation benefits from diverse perspectives, backgrounds and experiences. We encourage you to apply if you meet most, even if not all, of the following requirements:
 Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience
 Significant hands-on experience managing technology-powered products; typically 8+ years of related experience, though equivalent depth and impact are welcome
 Demonstrated understanding of a customer-centric product model and modern product discovery and delivery: identifying opportunities, testing assumptions, working across disciplines, and measuring outcomes. You can explain its value and help an organization adopt it in practice
 Experience setting product direction, defining success measures, prioritizing against customer and business outcomes, and delivering value through small, iterative releases
 Strong customer, analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to combine research, feedback and product data to make sound decisions and communicate trade-offs clearly
 Experience partnering closely with product design, technology leads and engineers; enough technical fluency to understand constraints and collaborate effectively without assuming engineering ownership
 People leadership and coaching skills, with the ability to develop Product Owners who own distinct product areas and work effectively within cross-functional teams.
 Business acumen and the ability to work across functions such as customer experience, finance, sales, marketing, operations, compliance and privacy; financial services experience is an asset
 Strong communication and stakeholder-influence skills, including the ability to build support for new ways of working through evidence, collaboration and visible results
 Understanding of end-to-end customer experience and dependencies across products; comfort with product, analytics and collaboration tools
 Fluent communication skills in English are required and bilingual skills in French are an asset
 Benefits

 Competitive compensation package that rewards and recognizes individual contributions
 Excellent health, dental and insurance benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees

 Matching contributions to our retirement program

 Regular social events to foster teamwork

We’re building a comprehensive, technology-enabled, client-centric wealth services ecosystem. Our clients include our partners, advisors, and investors.
